iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 56. RISING: IAEA releases gov2026-8 NPT safeguards report. New underground enrichment site at Isfahan - status unknown ('empty hall' or operational). JINSA report: Fordow expansion could allow 'several bombs worth of nuclear fuel per month'. 440kg 60% uranium location uncertain - possibly dispersed across Isfahan, Natanz, Fordow. Trump claims uranium 'deeply buried but under satellite surveillance'. IAEA still locked out of bombed facilities. Bulletin of Atomic Scientists: Iran likely transferred HEU to Isfahan before strikes. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability 33%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 56. BLOCKADE ACTIVE: US blockade of ALL Iranian ports since Apr 13. CENTCOM: no ships have passed blockade in first 36 hours. US-sanctioned Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite blockade - direct challenge. Iran FM says open to 2nd round talks if no 'unlawful demands'. Pakistan racing to arrange 2nd round US-Iran talks this week. IRGC threatens to bomb US warships. Saudi Arabia pushing US to remove blockade. Oil Brent ~$92. Ceasefire deadline Apr 22. Probability 68%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 56. ESCALATING: Washington talks BEGIN TOMORROW (Apr 15). Hezbollah leader Qassem REJECTS direct Lebanon-Israel negotiations as 'futile' and 'treason'. Israel REJECTS ceasefire ahead of Washington talks. Israel continues strikes, extending ground ops in south. 2,089+ killed, 1M+ displaced. Lebanese gov forced to negotiate under bombs. Hezbollah accuses gov of 'impotence'. Pope Leo XIV demands ceasefire. Probability 45%. Rising.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Erdogan announces $1B completed defense investments, $3B total project scale. New facilities for layered air defense and missile production. Tayfun hypersonic entering serial production. Goal: $11B defense exports by 2028 (top 10 globally). ~100 defense agreements. SAHA 2026 expo. Probability 14%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR survey continues to warn India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026. Drivers of conflict remain intact - terrorism from Pakistan. No major new developments. Pakistan also mediating Iran ceasefire. Probability 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 61. SUSTAINED: Medvedev nuclear threats expanded to Finland/Sweden. Russia profiting from Iran war - oil revenues surging billions. NATO frontline states welcoming nuclear cooperation with France. 2026 NPT Review shaping as battleground - Russia constructing narrative to shift blame. Danish intelligence: Russia could be ready for localized war against neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine fighting stops. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 66%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: Xi meets Taiwan opposition leader KMT chairwoman Cheng Li-wun in Beijing, warns 'absolutely not tolerate' independence. Taiwan tracking rising Chinese naval activity. US-sanctioned Chinese tanker TRANSITED Hormuz despite US blockade - direct challenge. Wang Yi visited Pyongyang - China-NK rail resumed, 'strategic communication' strengthened. PLA Type 055 destroyers completed live-fire drill. Taiwan reinforcing asymmetric defense. $14B US arms deal for Taiwan ready. Chinese sanctions on Japanese lawmaker over Taiwan ties. Probability 30%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 56. SUSTAINED: US ODNI 2026 Threat Assessment confirms NK ICBM can reach entire US mainland. Kim observed solid-fuel engine test - more powerful than September test, designed for Hwasong-20 ICBM. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Global distraction from Iran war gives NK cover. South Korea declared 'most hostile enemy'. Probability 85%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1156+. SUSTAINED: Russia chose 'Easter escalation' over ceasefire. 110+ drones targeting civilians. Patriot missile shortage concern as systems diverted to Iran theater. Russia regenerating tank force. Russia suffered 316 casualties per sq km in Q1 2026. Russia declares 'completed liberation' of Luhansk. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging. 1.2M Russian casualties estimated (325K killed). Probability 82%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: SUSTAINED: China-mediated ceasefire talks continue in Urumqi. Mid-level Afghan Taliban delegation sent. Fighting continues worst since Taliban 2021. Mortars killing civilians including children. Pakistan simultaneously mediating Iran ceasefire. Lowy Institute calls it 'the other war the world is ignoring'. Probability 22%. Stable.
